sysml:Requirement.Text: The quadcopter shall be battery powered.
The quadcopter shall be able to hover for 10 minutes at normal power draw.
The quadcopter shall interface with the ground station using an RF radio.
The quadcopter shall interface with the ground station using a WiFi radio.
The quadcopter weight shall not exceed 10 kg.
The quadcopter shall interface with the ground station using a 4G radio.
The quadcopter cost shall not exceed $1000 USD.
The quadcopter shall have four independent motors.
The quadcopter shall use the communication system to stream its video feed to the ground station.
The quadcopter shall have a visual sensor.
